devdoc.details: Ownerless. Deployed after the launch through `PleaLaunch.deployTribunal` from committed creation code; it reads every setting from its deployer. Its own EIP-712 domain means an attestation signed for the gate can never be replayed here, nor the reverse.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

StringsInsufficientHexLength(uint256,uin.details: The `value` string doesn't fit in the specified `length`.

EIP712DomainChanged().details: MAY be emitted to signal that the domain could have changed.

attestationDigest((bytes32,uint256,bytes.details: Public so an off-chain party — the attester, a test, a reader — can ask the consumer what it will check rather than reimplementing the domain. Equal to `oracleAttestationDigest` in the protocol package for the same consumer and message.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

DEFINITIONS.details: The gate's definitions, verbatim (a test checks they appear in `gate.body`), plus one: `objection`, version 2 (calibrated on Sepolia 2026-10-14: claims about anything outside the request carry no weight; version 1 let an unverifiable copying accusation move a 35 to 28).

devdoc.title: Tribunal — Objection! Challenging an approved plea's season points

MARGIN().notice: Sustained only when the new score is below the need by more than this (panel noise).

MAX_OBJECTIONS().notice: Objections per plea (ruled or pending); each must come from a different wallet.

OBJECTION_WINDOW().notice: Time after a plea's verdict during which anyone may object to it.

PENDING_EXPIRY().notice: An objection with no ruling after this is void (same as the gate's pending expiry).

attestationDigest((bytes32,uint256,bytes.notice: The digest the oracle signed: this consumer's domain over the attestation.

body(uint256).notice: The oracle body paid to the Intake: the gate's parameters, this contract as consumer.

consumed(bytes32).notice: Request ids this consumer has acted on, for consumers that call `_consume`.

expire(uint256).notice: Anyone may void a pending objection that can no longer be ruled: 20 minutes passed, or the Intake completed the request without an answer.

imd().notice: The stake asset: the pool's IMD.

object(uint256,string).notice: Objects to approved plea `pleaId`: pays the oracle fee and the stake, asks a fresh panel. Not the seller, not the owners Seasons excludes. Rulings plus pending objections stay within `MAX_OBJECTIONS`, every one from a different wallet; a stale pending one is voided first.

onObjectionFailure(bytes32,uint8,bytes32.notice: The Intake's failure function (refused, or no answer): the objection becomes void.

onOracleResult(bytes32,(bytes32,uint256,.notice: The Intake's callback: stores the signed re-score and the ruling, nothing else.

oracleAsset().notice: What the Intake is paid in; on Sepolia the Tribunal mints the test fee itself.

oracleSigner().notice: The address every attestation must verify against: a key, or a registry of keys.

question(uint256).notice: The question the second panel reads for objection `id` (plain text).

settle(uint256).notice: Pays a decided objection's stake once: to the objector when sustained or void, to the plea's season prize pot when overruled (rollover if that season has already closed).

standing(uint256).notice: What Seasons reads before recording a plea: whether its points must wait (the window is open or an objection is pending), whether an objection was sustained, and the lowest score a panel gave it (`NO_SCORE` when none has ruled).

userdoc.notice: After the Cabal approves a plea, other holders have `OBJECTION_WINDOW` to object: they write up to 280 bytes and pay the 0.5 IMD oracle fee plus a 0.35 IMD stake. A fresh panel of 30 re-scores the plea from scratch, reading the original question, the original score and the objection. The plea's recorded score can only fall: it becomes the lowest score any panel gave. If the new score is below the plea's need by more than `MARGIN`, the objection is SUSTAINED and the plea earns no points this season. Otherwise it is OVERRULED and the stake goes to the season's prize pot. A panel that gives no answer makes the objection VOID: the stake comes back, the oracle fee is spent, and the slot frees up while the window is open. At most `MAX_OBJECTIONS` objections per plea, each from a different wallet; the second need not wait for the first panel, so both may be pending at once. A sustain closes the case to new objections.The sale is never touched: an approved plea sells on its normal schedule. Points wait: Seasons records a plea only once its window has closed and no objection is pending.Objection rulings never reset the Cabal's dead-man; only plea verdicts do.
